plan.notes: Source: SUNY Schenectady official 'Business Administration (A.S.) Curriculum Worksheet 2026-2027' (HEGIS 5004, Program Code 55, sunysccc.edu/PDF/CurriculumWorksheets/55.pdf, Rev. 10/16/25). All four semesters transcribed exactly as published in the worksheet's First Year / Second Year Fall-Spring layout: 16+15+17+16 = 64, matching the published 'Minimum Credit Hours required for degree: 64' (variable-credit slots resolved at minimum: Second-Year Fall Natural Sciences SUNY Gen Ed Elective 3-5 transcribed at 3; Second-Year Spring 'MAT 180 Calculus I OR Natural Science SUNY General Education Elective' 3-5 transcribed as MAT 180 at 3; Restricted Elective 3-6 transcribed at 3; published ranges 64-73). Prerequisite ordering verified: BUS 121 Business Law I (Sem 1) before BUS 123 Business Law II (Sem 2); ENG 123 College Composition (Sem 1) before ENG 124 Literature and Writing (Sem 2); ACC 121 Financial Accounting (Sem 3) before ACC 122 Managerial Accounting (Sem 4); MAT 167 Precalculus w/ Analytic Geometry (Sem 3) before MAT 180 Calculus I (Sem 4). Published rules documented: Restricted Elective (a) chosen with a faculty advisor from BUS 252 Business Plan Development (off campus), MGT 127 Human Resource Management, MGT 215 Sales and Service (online), MGT 250 Business Internship, or MGT 251 Disney Cooperative; SUNY General Education = at least 7 distinct knowledge and skill areas with Communication, DEISJ & CD, Mathematics, and Natural Sciences required plus both core competencies (Critical Thinking, Information Literacy). Degree classification: AS = transfer-oriented (worksheet feeds Siena College articulation for Accounting/Business/Economics/Finance/Management/Marketing).
